title: How to Identify Profit Leaks in Your Business (Not Just Revenue)
description: Identify profit leaks by connecting funnel gaps to margin — discount creep, scope creep, CAC waste, and recovery opportunities.

faq.a: Revenue you lose or margin you give away through operational gaps — not just top-line shortfalls.

faq.q: How is a profit leak different from revenue leakage?
faq.a: Revenue leakage focuses on uncaptured sales. Profit leaks include margin erosion: discounts, refunds, unpaid scope, and inefficient acquisition.

blocks.text: To identify profit leaks, follow dollars past the sale. A lead that never converts wastes CAC. A client who gets free scope erodes margin. A failed renewal kills LTV. Same funnel, different accounting lens.

items: Discounts that never expire or auto-renew at promo rates
Refund rate spikes on specific products or cohorts
Sales cycle length growing while close rate falls
Support load from customers who never activated
Invoices paid late — cash timing hurts runway

blocks.text: Measure funnel leaks first with [revenue leakage detection](/blog/revenue-leakage-detection), then layer unit economics. Full playbooks: [identify profit leaks](/guides/identify-profit-leaks) and [profit leakage recovery](/blog/profit-leakage-recovery).
